notes.title: Behind the Dice: Enrage
notes.content: [h2]Hello, and welcome back to Behind the Dice![/h2][p][/p][p]This week, we asked the devs: [i]What is something you have recently finished working on?[/i] They told us that they recently finished the [i]enrage[/i] system, where the foes get angrier the longer the fights last.[/p][p][/p][h3]Read on to find out more about what their thought process behind implementing the enrage system: [/h3][p][/p][p]The enrage system was a solution to the problem I created with re-rolls. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057648/7b60e4bd4e747fddd6b92dabdd5e7fb31b9f27d0.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Here's what the enrage symbol looks like in the game.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Re-rolls are necessary in the game, as they allow much more player agency within a ruleset (the ruleset of Farkle) that relies almost completely on RNG. Without rerolls the player would have even fewer ways to express their control. However, if we give the player too many re-rolls, they have too much control, and basically nullify the challenge of the game. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057648/577e24df6a7cffbcf32337b8cf5d77c588f18723.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057648/d95d1554eb69a9ac50c3d4012c01ad872d28376a.png"][/img][/p][p][i]As you can see, the enemy really doesn't like you re-rolling and is now enraged x2. Oops.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Currently there are ways to amass great amounts of re-rolls, but because that is a build choice, it comes at the expense of other things like multiplication and raw PWR. This would lead to a situation where players understandably chose builds that gave them the most control, but they actually ended up playing a very boring game, of lots and lots of tiny scoring hands. This is not what Dicealot is about. We want big numbers. [/p][p][/p][p]The worst thing about these builds is that whilst reliable, they make the game incredibly slow. So the enrage system is a simple mechanic that essentially makes the enemies hit you harder the longer the fight lasts, by rolling extra opponent dice. Because of this, these boring slow builds are no longer viable.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057648/d574471fe29333507c2bbf61094f2f4bbf8b6762.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057648/59a8a9537410d08322376acee20934bf04d02641.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Look at those extra dice. That hurts.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Like everything else, its also another fun variable to play with. So we are adding some things that react to enemy rage, and including the rage timer as a variable when it comes to higher difficulties.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]If you want to know more about enrage, or have any other questions about the game and its development process, ask us here and we may just include it in our next Behind the Dice![/p]

notes.title: Dice Dimensions and What's New!
notes.content:
Hear ye fellow dice-rollers!

I know it's been quiet on our end, but big things are brewing in the kingdom of Dicealot! We've been hard at work, and we're excited to share some updates that are sure to get your dice rolling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057648/f3bd2e1a3e5e79a1b3aff58ccc88198e4e4f032e.png[/img]

[h2]Dice Dimensions Event[/h2]

First up, we're thrilled to be part of the Dice Dimensions Steam event, running from March 5th to 12th! If you've been curious about Dicealot, now's the perfect time to check us out! Our demo is live so give it a try if you haven't yet!

[h2]What's New [/h2]

We've been working on some cool new additions to spice up your Dicealot adventures!

Act 3: We're introducing new Quests and Bosses that will be sure to test your skills!

New Map, New Shop: Say goodbye to the old single-shop setup - we're implementing a brand new map screen that lets you choose from multiple different shops between fights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057648/77ac505ab1d5f171536b98de88bdc3a5a69c088b.png[/img]

We do heartily hope thou dost enjoy thy sojourn within our Kingdom, whether thou hast dwelt here since the dawning or art but newly come. Stayest thou tuned for tidings yet to come, and may fortune smile upon the bold!

notes.title: November for Dicealot!
notes.content:
Hello fellow dice-rollers!

Here's a quick low down on what we've been up to last month!

[h2][b][url=https://gamayo.co.uk/2024/11/22/gamayo-success-at-wx/]GaMaYo![/url][/b][/h2]

Our first event with a playable build of Dicealot, we got to see first-hand playthroughs (as well as backseat game everyone that tried our demo) and got tons of great feedback.

Sir Dicealot was in attendance, teaching people the base game of Farkle and non-lethally dueling them on the arena of dice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057648/4d728fb358d9783c3308cf84842ce565d4c87d45.jpg[/img]

You can read an interview from the event with the dev team [url=https://gamayo.co.uk/2024/11/21/gamayo-23-showcase-26-dicealot-at-gamayo/]here[/url]

[h2][b]Admin![/b][/h2]

Everyone's favourite, we've been building up the backend so that we can get ourselves positioned for a successful release.

That means talking to publishers, putting various business development structures in place and all the other boring, paperwork related things required for us to support the game.

[h2][b]Development![/b][/h2]

Development in November was mostly focused on creating a more dynamic tutorial (give it a try if you haven't yet!) and making the game easier to play for new players. Of course there's always bug fixes going on, and more recently we've been implementing a post-battle reward screen (with individual opponents having their own weighted loot-tables).

Thanks for all the support so far and stay tuned for more news on a possible release date and updated features coming soon!

implementing a post-battle reward screen (with individual opponents having their own weighted loot-tables).

notes.title: Demo Update - V0.5.15
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Questers!

Yesterday's update targeted a few big pieces of feedback from Nextfest as well as squashing the cause of a common crash

[b]New Features[/b]

- Auto-banking - Once you roll, double click on any dice to automatically send it to the bottom row and bank it. You can still drag if you prefer but this should speed up grinding through those hands in your 1s and 5s builds!

- Manual dice re-positioning on the board - Want to sort your dice on the board or remove those pesky overlaps? Click and drag the dice somewhere else on the game board.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

- Implented a fix for the crashing when banking a 6 dice combo. This hit quite a few people so please let us know if you still hit this crash after this update!

Also included are various balance and price changes for existing quest and power dice

As always, jump on our discord if you want to chat with us, make suggestions, or report any issues!

[url=Dicealot Discord]https://discord.gg/XTB2XB4PSp[/url]
